en: For the love of all that's holy, what are you doing out there? Brother Tarkus was your responsibility!

en: Hah! You humies come fer a fight, yeah? I'll give ya a fight!

en: Ya trying ta stop me fun, eh humie. Well come on\, then. Dok Grot's gots nuff surjery skills for the lot o' ya!

notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat early campaign polish

en: We should flank them. Another entrance could be less defended.

notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat flank line polish

en: Dat's good work, but dere's anudder camp to da south.  Betcha we can hit 'em from the rear, what dey call a 'flankin' manoover'

en: You boyz work for Boss Boartoof now.  'ead on up ter 'is camp.

notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat ork dialogue polish

en: Consume mass quantities!
zh_new: 大口吞噬！
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat voice polish

en: The Eldar are stirring up the Orks in the sector, and trying to stir up a massive Waaaghh! Why they are doing this is a mystery, but Captain Thule fears the worst.
zh_new: 靈族正在煽動星區內的獸人，試圖引發一場大規模 WAAAGH！他們為何這麼做仍是謎團，但圖勒連長擔心最壞情況。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat WAAAGH prose polish

en: Earn Waaagh! by fighting and killing your enemies.
zh_new: 透過戰鬥並殺死敵人來獲得 WAAAGH！
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat WAAAGH prose polish

en: Channel the power of da Waaagh! to make all nearby boyz faster and harder to kill.
zh_new: 引導 WAAAGH 的力量，使附近所有小子移動更快，也更難被殺死。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat WAAAGH prose polish

en: Release the power of the Waaagh! to stun nearby enemies and temporarily boost the speed, damage and defense of nearby Ork infantry.
zh_new: 釋放 WAAAGH 的力量震暈附近敵人，並暫時提升附近獸人步兵的速度、傷害與防禦。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat WAAAGH prose polish

en: Upgrades your Stronghold to level 2.  Unlock Devastator Plasma Cannon Squad, Dreadnought, Razorback and Librarian.
zh_new: 將據點升至等級 2。解鎖毀滅者等離子炮小隊、無畏機甲、剃刀背運兵車和智庫。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unlock text polish

en: Upgrades your Stronghold to level 3. Unlocks Predator Tank.
zh_new: 將據點升至等級 3。解鎖掠食者坦克。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unlock text polish

en: Upgrades your Teleporta Platform to level 2. Unlock Stikkbommaz, Tankbustas, Wartrukk, Deff Dread and Weirdboy.
zh_new: 將傳送平台升至等級 2。解鎖棒槌炸彈小子、坦克殺手、戰鬥卡車、死無畏和怪異小子。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unlock text polish

en: Upgrades your Teleporta Platform to level 3. Unlock Nob Squad, Kommando, and Looted Tank.
zh_new: 將傳送平台升至等級 3。解鎖老大兵小隊、突擊隊小子和掠奪坦克。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unlock text polish

en: Gives the Farseer the Time Field ability which slows down movement in an area and makes units unable to attack. Increases health of the Farseer.
zh_new: 賦予先知「時間力場」技能，可減緩區域內單位移動並使其無法攻擊。提高先知生命值。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat ability text polish

en: Throw a grenade which temporarily counters gravity, incapacitating nearby units.
zh_new: 投擲一枚手雷，暫時反轉重力，使附近單位失去行動能力。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat ability text polish

en: You earn Greater Good points by killing enemy units and dying in combat. Spend the resource on the Tau's global abilities
zh_new: 透過擊殺敵方單位和在戰鬥中死亡獲得大義點數。將此資源用於鈦族的全局能力。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat Tau text polish

en: A prized relic of the Blood Ravens 9th company, this missile launcher last saw service during a bold raid on Tau armored columns during the Kaurava Campaign. By the time the sun rose fully over the Clement Hills, thirty Tau skimmer-tanks and crisis suits were smoking ruins.
zh_new: 血鴉第九連珍藏的上古聖物。這具導彈發射器最後一次服役，是在考拉瓦戰役中一次大膽突襲鈦族裝甲縱隊之時。當太陽完全升上仁慈丘陵時，三十輛鈦族浮空坦克與危機戰鬥服都已化為冒煙廢墟。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat Tau relic lore polish

en: Tough melee troops equipped with a Choppa and Slugga. Can be upgraded with Burnas and with a Nob Leader to unlock the Swamp Em' ability.
zh_new: 裝備砍刀和手槍的堅韌近戰部隊。可升級火焰噴射器，並升級老大頭領以解鎖「淹沒他們」能力。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unit description polish

en: Can be upgraded with the Big Shoota which grants the Aiming? Wotz Dat? ability. Can also be upgraded with a Nob Leader for greater durability.
zh_new: 可升級大槍，獲得「瞄準？那是啥？」能力。也可升級老大頭領以提高耐久。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unit description polish

en: Lightly armored melee unit.  Can also bombard units from a distance with Stikkbombz.

notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unit description polish

en: Gives the Apothecary more health, health regeneration and grants the Advanced Healing ability that allows him to heal allies that are near him. If the Apothecary is knocked unconscious, there is a chance he will be revived shortly after.
zh_new: 提高藥劑師生命值與生命恢復，並賦予進階治療能力，使他能治療附近盟友。若藥劑師失去意識，有機率在短時間後復甦。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unit description polish

en: Excels at stealth and hit and run attacks. Gives fear debuffs to nearby enemies when it attacks. Increases the the fear debuff that all Lictors cause to enemies they attack
zh_new: 擅長滲透和打帶跑攻擊。攻擊時會對附近敵人施加恐懼減益，並提高所有利卡特對攻擊目標造成的恐懼效果。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unit description polish

en: Fast and disruptive, excels at rushing into enemy lines or surprising them by tunneling beneath them. Grants the Fleet of Claw ability to Raveners.
zh_new: 迅捷且擅長擾亂敵軍，適合衝入敵陣，或從地下掘進突襲敵人。賦予掘蟒蟲「迅捷之爪」能力。
notes: 2026-05-17 14:19 JST main chat unit description polish

en: sneaky boy who likes to stab and shoot from the shadows, grants Kommando Squad big shootas
